# (busbar-kernel, busbar-substrate-values, busbar-contract, api): the vocabulary a duplex live
# session drags in, which only the plane that serves such sessions may spell. One lowercase noun
# per line; the detector matches each as a word (`_` is a boundary) and as a CamelCase token.

# Data, not source: the scanner's own `.rs` spells no word it bans (the fixture shape every
# no-plane-names scanner in this tree uses).
